title: Quest NetVault Backup StnzCreateKey Numeric Truncation Error Denial-of-Service Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-13269)
description: CVE-2026-13269 is a denial-of-service vulnerability in Quest NetVault Backup caused by a numeric truncation error in the StnzCreateKey function. This flaw allows remote attackers to cause a denial-of-service without requiring authentication by exploiting improper validation of user-supplied data.
